This smartphone UI screen is from the thredUP app, which appears to be a login or sign-up interface. The main contents and functions of this screen include:

1. **Account Selection Popup**: A dialog box prompts the user to choose an account for thredUP. It displays an existing account (appcrawler2@gmail.com) and provides an option to use another account.

2. **Login Option**: Below the popup, there is a text link for existing members to log in.

3. **Sign-Up Options**: There is a green button labeled "Sign up with Email" for new users to create an account using their email.

4. **Social Media Sign-Up/Log-In**: There are buttons for signing up or logging in using various social media accounts, including Amazon, Facebook, and Google.

The screen also shows the status bar at the top with standard icons for notifications, battery, and time.
